title: Elp1 is required for myeloid differentiation and brain repopulation
title_zh: Elp1在髓系分化和脑再殖中必不可少
abstract: Haematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) transplantation-mediated replacement of microglia—the reconstitution of the central nervous system microglial niche with donor-derived myeloid cells—represents a promising strategy for brain cell therapies1–7. However, the cell-intrinsic molecular regulators of HSPC-derived myeloid lineage commitment in the brain have remained largely uncharacterized. This is partially because the scarcity of primary HSPCs has rendered large-scale genetic interrogation intractable. Here we explored whether ex vivo expansion of primary cultured HSPCs (cHSPCs) enables unbiased genetic interrogation of haematopoietic differentiation. We established that cHSPCs can be genetically manipulated and readily differentiate into myeloid cells and repopulate microglia niches of the brain after transplantation. Moreover, primary neonatal astrocytes contained strong signals to induce myeloid specification of cHSPCs in vitro. To identify genes that regulate glia-induced myeloid differentiation, we successfully screened around 20,000 individual genetic perturbations and characterized genes involved in the regulation of cell signalling, cell cycle, mitochondrial function and protein translation. Among these genes was elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1 (Elp1), which suppressed the unfolded protein response during myeloid specification and was essential for the generation but not maintenance of myeloid cells. Our work establishes a platform to investigate the molecular mechanisms of brain myeloid biology. Primary cultured haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells are used to analyse the molecular mechanisms of brain myeloid differentiation, and this platform enabled the identification of elongation factor ELP1 as an important regulator of this process.
abstract_zh: 髓源性干细胞和前体细胞（HSPC）移植介导的微胶质细胞替代——即将供体来源的髓系细胞重建为中枢神经系统微胶质细胞小环境——是脑细胞治疗的一种有前景的策略1–7。然而，HSPC来源髓系谱系在脑内承诺的细胞内分子调节因子知之甚少。部分原因是主要HSPCs的稀缺使得大规模基因功能筛选变得不可行。在此，我们探讨是否可以通过体外扩增主要培养的HSPCs（cHSPCs）来实现髓系分化的无偏基因功能筛选。我们建立了cHSPCs可以进行基因操纵，并能分化为髓系细胞并在移植后重新殖民脑微环境。此外，初代星形胶质细胞在体内含有强烈的信号，可在体外诱导cHSPCs进行髓系谱系指定。为了鉴定调控胶质诱导髓系分化的基因，我们成功筛选了约20,000个个体基因突变，并表征了参与信号通路、细胞周期、线粒体功能和蛋白质翻译调控的基因。其中的一个基因是延伸酰基转移酶复合物亚基1（Elp1），它在髓系谱系指定期间抑制了未折叠蛋白应答，且对髓系细胞的生成而非维持是必不可少的。我们的研究建立了一个平台，用于研究脑髓系生物学的分子机制。利用主要培养的干细胞和前体细胞来分析脑髓系分化的分子机制，该平台使得关键调节因子ELP1在该过程中起重要作用。
